Hello,

I'm trying to use the "isStrandSpecific" option in featureCounts in R (Rsubread 1.20.20 and I am getting an error message saying

"Error in featureCounts(bams, annot.ext = "/Volumes/Data2/genomes/Mus_musculus/Ensembl/GRCm38/Annotation/Genes/genes.gtf",  :
  unused argument (isStrandSpecific = 2)"

Why is that? Are there any other options that should be used in order to use this option?

Thanks for any advice in this regard
Cheers
Guillermo
